name: Abu Ja'far al-Khazin
contribution: An Iranian Muslim astronomer and mathematician from Khorasan.
legacy: One of this person's works Zij al-Safa'ih was described by his successors as the best work in the field and they make many references to it.

checks.lead: Abu Jafar Muhammad ibn Husayn Khazin (Persian: ابوجعفر خازن خراسانی; 900–971), also called Al-Khazin, was an Iranian Muslim astronomer and mathematician from Khorasan. He worked on both astronomy and number theory.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
